cases.name: create_view
cases.note: confirm a view is allowed, which is why no rule refuses one
steps: CREATE VIEW baseline_v AS SELECT 1 AS x

cases.name: create_sequence
cases.note: confirm a sequence with no CACHE is refused
steps: CREATE SEQUENCE baseline_seq

observations.message: CREATE SEQUENCE is not supported without an explicit cache size. please define CACHE greater than or equal to 65536 or equal to 1

cases.name: create_sequence_cached
cases.note: sequences with high CACHE may be allowed
steps: CREATE SEQUENCE baseline_seq2 CACHE 65536

cases.name: create_schema
steps: CREATE SCHEMA baseline_schema

cases.name: select_one
steps: SELECT 1

cases.name: show_transaction_isolation
steps: SHOW transaction_isolation

cases.name: select_version
steps: SELECT version()

cases.name: insert_returning
steps: INSERT INTO baseline_idx (id, value) VALUES ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000dd', 'v1') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING value

cases.name: select_count
steps: SELECT count(*) FROM baseline_idx

cases.name: update_row
steps: UPDATE baseline_idx SET value = 'v2' WHERE id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000dd'

cases.name: delete_row
steps: DELETE FROM baseline_idx WHERE id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000dd'

cases.name: cte
steps: WITH x AS (SELECT 1 AS n) SELECT n FROM x

cases.name: join
steps: SELECT p.name FROM baseline_parent p JOIN baseline_child c ON c.parent_id = p.id

observations.message: insert or update on table "baseline_child" violates foreign key constraint "baseline_child_parent_id_fkey"

cases.name: identity_column
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, value text)

observations.message: identity column is not supported without an explicit cache size. please define CACHE greater than or equal to 65536 or equal to 1

cases.name: deferrable_foreign_key
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_deferred (id int PRIMARY KEY, parent_id uuid REFERENCES baseline_parent(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

cases.name: alter_table_add_column
steps: ALTER TABLE baseline_idx ADD COLUMN extra text

cases.name: drop_table
steps: DROP TABLE baseline_drop_me

cases.name: identity_column_cached
cases.note: confirm identity with a large CACHE is allowed
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity_cached (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY (CACHE 65536) PRIMARY KEY, value text)

cases.name: identity_integer
cases.note: an integer identity column: refused, naming the type?
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity_int (id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (CACHE 1) PRIMARY KEY)

observations.message: datatype integer not supported, identity column type must be bigint

cases.name: identity_smallint
cases.note: confirm the restriction is to bigint rather than to integer alone
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity_small (id smallint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (CACHE 1) PRIMARY KEY)

observations.message: datatype smallint not supported, identity column type must be bigint

cases.name: identity_bigint_by_default
cases.note: the form the restriction leaves, with the smallest allowed CACHE
steps: CREATE TABLE baseline_identity_big (id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (CACHE 1) PRIMARY KEY)

cases.name: create_sequence_cache_one
steps: CREATE SEQUENCE baseline_seq_one CACHE 1
